electric_supply_share.source: Approximate generation (standard service) share of the 2022 residential bill: Eversource/UI standard service averaged roughly 10-11 c/kWh in 2022 vs a 24.61 c/kWh all-in average (EIA). Municipal utilities buy through CMEEC and have lower delivery charges, so supply is a larger share.

generation.source: Baseline shares: ISO New England 2024 net energy for load (gas 51%, nuclear 23%, net imports 9%, hydro 7%, solar 4%, wind 3%, other ~3%). Costs are illustrative all-in $/MWh energy costs for comparing mixes, not market prices.
